[[Ritualist Insignia]] }} This quest is actually the selection of a [[secondary profession]] for [[Factions]] character. A profession is immediately gained upon selecting it as the quest acceptance alternative. It is then complete. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions }} * [[An Audience with Master Togo]] for at least one profession other than the primary. ===Objectives=== * Seek out at least one headmaster and complete that headmaster's training. ===Reward=== * 3,500 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * [[Monastery Credit]] ==Walkthrough== Talk to Master Togo and select which secondary profession you want, then speak with him again for the quest reward if you wish to keep the chosen profession. If you are unsure about whether you wish to keep this secondary profession, you may choose not to take the reward, giving you the chance to choose again if able, though it is unconfirmed whether you can purchase skills from a [[Skill Trainer]] at such a stage. This is a rather straightforward quest, though which secondary profession will be best to take will vary on your [[primary profession]] or playing style. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Master Togo ''Now that you have completed training in some of the other professions and learned more about them, it is time to make a choice. Think carefully, now. Once you decide, you will not be able to change your mind.'' ''Which secondary profession would you like to choose?'' :{{yes|ingame}} '''I will take Ritualist as my secondary profession.''' (only if not primary assassin and [[An Audience with Master Togo (assassin)]] is completed.) :{{no|ingame}} '''I am not ready to choose.''' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Master Togo ''A fitting choice, young one. Congratulations. You now have the choice of returning to your Headmaster to earn your insignia for your primary profession, or you can take a further quest from me. Although it is your choice, I recommend that you speak with your Headmaster first and return to me once you have earned your insignia.'' ==Notes== *Despite what Togo claims, further on in the story, you will gain the ability to change secondary profession. *After choosing a secondary profession, consider speaking with your headmaster and earning your insignia. It is possible to [[unlock]] all of the skills related to each training quest without having to do the quests. This is done by accepting the quest from [[Instructor Ng]], receiving the skills, then abandoning the quest. [[Category:Rewards Monastery Credit]]
